notes: Full description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs DeviationStore::add() at lines 431-446. The method panics (via assert!) if a deviation with the same ID already exists. The doc comment at line 427 says 'Panics if... a deviation with the same id already exists in the store. These are programming errors; the store does not accept incomplete or duplicate deviations.' Using panic for a duplicate ID check is reasonable in a compile-time configuration context, but deviations are expected to be loaded from external stores (YAML, database, etc. per the module doc). In those contexts, a duplicate ID in the external configuration is a data error, not a programming error, and should return Result::Err to allow callers to handle gracefully. Currently any server that loads deviations from a configuration file and encounters a duplicate will crash. Fix: Change add() to return Result<(), DeviationError> or similar, where DeviationError includes a DuplicateId variant. Alternatively, rename the method to add_unchecked() and provide an add() that returns Result. The existing panic-on-duplicate tests use #[should_panic] which would need updating. Priority: P2 (API correctness — panic in recovery code is inappropriate for data-layer errors).
title: FINDING: DeviationStore::add() panics on duplicate ID instead of returning Result
